# Read Parquet and create a transformed dataset.
storage = "abfss://migrationcontainer@transportationmigration.dfs.core.windows.net"

sales_df = spark.read.parquet(
    storage + "/migration-test/parquet/sales"
)

customers_df = spark.read.parquet(
    storage + "/migration-test/parquet/customers"
)

result = (
    sales_df.join(customers_df, "CustomerId", "left")
    .groupBy("City", "Product")
    .sum("Amount")
    .withColumnRenamed("sum(Amount)", "TotalAmount")
)

display(result)

result.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    storage + "/migration-test/processed/sales_by_city_product"
)

print("Transformation completed.")
